from pathlib import Path
import json

home = Path.home()
done_task = "CONT-DONE-eba52c84b60e5eb693d28b3d"
cid = "CONT-eba52c84b60e5eb693d28b3d"

tp = home / ".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks" / f"{done_task}.json"
cp = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge/continuations" / f"{cid}.json"

assert tp.is_file(), "DONE_TASK_STATE_MISSING"
assert cp.is_file(), "CONTINUATION_STATE_MISSING"

task = json.loads(tp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
cont = json.loads(cp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

assert task.get("task_id") == done_task, task
assert task.get("status") == "DISPATCHED", task
assert task.get("parent_continuation_id") == cid, task
assert task.get("auto_continue") is False, task

assert cont.get("continuation_id") == cid, cont
assert cont.get("expected_done_task_id") == done_task, cont
assert cont.get("state") == "DONE", cont

print("A_B_DONE_CANARY=PASS")
print("DONE_RECEIPT_DISPATCHED=PASS")
print("CONTINUATION_TERMINAL_DONE=PASS")
print("HUMAN_CONTINUE_REQUIRED=NO")
